# Tobiah Naskley

Tobiah Naskley is a Billing Analyst at Vorrel Cloud, where he specializes in managing insurance claims processing and streamlining reimbursement workflows for dental clinics. Joining Vorrel Cloud in 2021, Tobiah has been instrumental in advancing the company’s flagship platform, Project ClearClaim, which automates insurance submissions and tracks approval status in real time.

Prior to Vorrel Cloud, Tobiah worked from 2016 to 2021 at MedFinance Systems, focusing on billing data integrity and denial management. There, he developed an error reduction protocol during Project ClaimGuard that decreased claim denials by 20%, significantly improving revenue cycle efficiency for client clinics.

Tobiah’s working style emphasizes data-driven analysis combined with close collaboration across billing, clinical, and IT teams to identify bottlenecks. He regularly partners with the product managers, insurance liaison officers, and software engineers to implement iterative workflow enhancements and training initiatives.

Current employer: [[companies/vorrel-cloud]].
